scenarios.mech: Finalize substantially unchanged harmonised recommendations for demonstrating veterinary anthelmintic effectiveness.

forecasts.notes: International harmonisation generally favors continuity in technical content. FDA guidance finalisation can take years; without draft age or consultation status, the six-month estimate remains a broad base-rate forecast.
missing: Draft publication date and full text

scenarios.mech: Finalize the proposed intentional-adulteration mitigation framework, primarily clarifying implementation.
Allow more flexible approaches to implementing recommended mitigation strategies.

forecasts.notes: Broad operational guidance can require substantial stakeholder reconciliation. With no draft date, text or timetable, FDA guidance base rates imply a modest six-month finalisation probability and considerable timing uncertainty.

scenarios.mech: Adopt a standard process linking mutual fund folio opening with execution of the first investment.
Adopt the common process with longer implementation periods or exceptions for operational constraints.

forecasts.notes: Operational standardisation consultations can produce SEBI circulars within several months. Unknown consultation age and implementation dependencies limit confidence; transition relief is a plausible conditional modification.

scenarios.mech: Finalize 510(k) recommendations covering peripheral PTA balloons and specialty catheters, retaining the listed device categories.
Retain the device scope while allowing greater flexibility in recommended supporting information for 510(k) submissions.

forecasts.notes: The draft is nearly two years old, allowing time for review but providing no reliable completion signal. Its bounded technical scope favors substantive continuity if finalized; FDA guidance timelines remain highly variable.

scenarios.mech: Retain development recommendations for locally applied corticosteroids treating short-term symptoms associated with internal or external hemorrhoids.

forecasts.notes: Narrow clinical-development guidance typically preserves its core scope, but finalisation timing is weakly predictable. No draft age, study recommendations or publication schedule is supplied.

scenarios.mech: Finalize recommendations for incorporating patient engagement into the design and conduct of medical device clinical investigations.
Give sponsors more discretion over when and how to incorporate patient engagement.

forecasts.notes: Process-oriented guidance plausibly receives clarifications or flexibility rather than wholesale redesign. FDA guidance base rates dominate timing because draft age and consultation progress are unknown.

scenarios.mech: Retain integrated IND and BA/BE safety-reporting recommendations, including aggregate-data assessment for the two identified IND provisions.
Preserve aggregate safety assessment while allowing more flexibility in recommended sponsor implementation methods.

forecasts.notes: The replacement draft is only six months old and incorporates stakeholder revisions to a 2015 draft. That history suggests substantial review complexity; withdrawing the predecessor does not imply withdrawal of this proposal.

scenarios.mech: Finalize common content and format recommendations for patient instructions across the drug, biological and combination products identified in the title.
Allow more variation in recommended content or format to accommodate differences among covered products.

forecasts.notes: Cross-product labeling guidance may require coordination and implementation clarifications. Without the draft or review timeline, a low near-term hazard and modest six-month probability are appropriate FDA guidance base rates.

scenarios.mech: Finalize the proposed framework for developing drugs to treat chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps.
Retain the indication while permitting greater flexibility in recommended clinical development approaches.

forecasts.notes: Disease-specific drug-development guidance generally retains its central framework when finalized. Timing cannot be anchored without draft age or review milestones, so the estimate follows broad FDA guidance base rates.

scenarios.mech: Finalize recommendations governing biomarkers and surrogate endpoints used to support effectiveness of new animal drugs.
Permit greater flexibility in recommended evidence supporting use of biomarkers or surrogate endpoints.

forecasts.notes: Scientific evidentiary guidance can require prolonged technical review. With no draft date or criteria provided, timing and content estimates are uncertain base-rate judgments rather than assessments of a known proposal.
missing: Draft date and proposed evidentiary criteria

scenarios.mech: Adopt the proposed enhancements to the Straight-Through Processing framework for institutional trade messaging.
Adopt core messaging changes with longer transition periods or narrower initial implementation.

forecasts.notes: SEBI operational framework consultations can conclude within months, but technical implementation coordination can delay adoption or produce phased requirements. No consultation date, proposed standards or readiness evidence is supplied.

scenarios.mech: Amend stock-exchange administration provisions in the master circular substantially along the proposed ease-of-doing-business approach.
Adopt the modifications with further carve-outs or longer compliance transitions.

forecasts.notes: Targeted administrative amendments generally have fewer implementation dependencies than major structural reforms. This supports a moderately high six-month adoption probability, though unknown scope and consultation stage leave substantial uncertainty.
